_comment: Published reference numbers that anchor Population Pulse. Every entry carries its source and a verification status. Edit this file when better numbers are obtained (for example from the GBD Results Tool or the IJMR paper itself).

india_ckd_cases_2023.source: Global Burden of Disease 2023 (Lancet), India second-highest in the world after China (152 million); reported by The Week (PTI) 8 Nov 2025 and CSR Journal
india_ckd_cases_2023.status: taken from news reports of the paper; verify against the Lancet GBD 2023 paper or the GBD Results Tool

seek_adult_prevalence.source: Singh AK et al. SEEK study, BMC Nephrology 2013;14:114. 6120 people screened at 13 centres; CKD by eGFR<60 (MDRD) or proteinuria
seek_adult_prevalence.status: verified from the paper abstract; screened sample, not a random population sample

prevalence_trend_pct_per_year.source: Meshram HS, Chauhan S, Puri S. Indian Journal of Medical Research, GBD 2023 India CKD study; reported by Outlook India 2 Jul 2026: national prevalence declining about 0.22% a year, 1990-2023
prevalence_trend_pct_per_year.status: taken from a news report; verify against the paper. Applied to age-specific rates

state_ckd_mortality_per_lakh_2023._source: Same IJMR / GBD 2023 study via The South First (Telangana highest in India; Rajasthan lowest at 6.71). West Bengal value not reported in the article.
state_ckd_mortality_per_lakh_2023._status: taken from a news report; verify against the paper

census2011_population._source: Census of India 2011 (Andhra Pradesh = undivided 84,580,777 minus Telangana)
census2011_population._status: entered by hand; verify against censusindia.gov.in. State shares are held constant over time, which is a simplification

region_rate_multiplier._note: Relative CKD rate of each state versus India. All 1.0 because no verified state prevalence numbers are loaded yet: states differ in reality (Haryana highest, per the IJMR study). Fill from GBD state data to make regional differences data-informed.

_notes.dialysis_fraction_of_stage5: ASSUMPTION: share of people with eGFR<15 who need maintenance dialysis (others: transplant, conservative care, died). Adjustable.
_notes.dialysis_sessions_per_patient_year: 3 sessions a week x 52 weeks (standard haemodialysis schedule)
_notes.sessions_per_station_year: ASSUMPTION: 3 shifts a day x 6 days x 52 weeks
_notes.visits_per_nephrologist_year: ASSUMPTION: clinic workload per nephrologist; adjustable

faster_decline.label: What if age-specific rates fell 1% a year (hypothetical: better diabetes and BP control)

rising.label: What if age-specific rates rose 1% a year (hypothetical: more diabetes and obesity)
